---
title: "00 — Configuration du projet"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## 1. Chargement des packages

```{r packages}
# Installe les packages manquants automatiquement
packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "janitor", "skimr", "here", "lubridate")

installed <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(!installed)) install.packages(packages[!installed])

lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

## 2. Définition des chemins

```{r chemins}
# Tous les chemins du projet
path_raw       <- here::here("data", "raw")
path_external  <- here::here("data", "external")
path_interim   <- here::here("data", "interim")
path_processed <- here::here("data", "processed")
path_final     <- here::here("data", "final")
path_figures   <- here::here("figures")
path_outputs   <- here::here("outputs")
path_logs      <- here::here("logs")

cat("✅ Chemins définis avec succès\n")
```

## 3. Options globales

```{r options}
options(scipen = 999)          # Pas de notation scientifique
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "fr_FR.UTF-8")  # Dates en français

cat("✅ Options configurées\n")
```

## 4. Vérification de la structure

```{r verification}
dossiers <- c(path_raw, path_external, path_interim,
              path_processed, path_final, path_figures,
              path_outputs, path_logs)

for (d in dossiers) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("✅ Structure du projet vérifiée\n")
```
